scope: Independent source-grounded semantic fixtures. These are review expectations, not a completed runtime test report.
quantity_contract: Quantity belongs to the pictured referent. A numbered actor, a part of an object, a grouping count and a total are different concepts. Repeated PNG instances should preserve the original source pixels.

limits: The fixtures cover known failure modes, not every action in the 1096-story catalog.

Asset availability, hidden-help protection, sprite layout and final visible counts require separate runtime verification.
